subject: Mutual action plan: capacity milestones, lead-time checkpoints and reservation agreement
messages:
From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity support & MAP for evaluation -> reservation

Vanessa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Greenleaf would like to document a mutual action plan that ties the evaluation milestones to a formal capacity reservation (Dedicated or Private) so we can secure GPU availability for our pilot and meet our Q1 timeline. A few things we need to capture:

- Expected lead time for Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) once contract is signed.
- Lead time and validation window for the Private (on-prem/VPC) option — including any on-site validation or image certification steps.
- Recommended pilot GPU pool sizing (baseline + burst) for our workload (2–3B token monthly throughput).
- A proposed schedule showing milestones and owners through pilot kickoff.

Could you send a draft MAP and initial sizing assumptions? Procurement is starting their Q1 budget review and we’d like to lock dates where possible. I attached our RFP and a short workload summary.

Attachments: RFP-Greenleaf-2026.pdf

Thanks,
Claire Dunn
Head of Cloud Procurement
Greenleaf Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity support & MAP for evaluation -> reservation

Claire —

Appreciate the clear ask and the RFP. I’ve started a draft MAP and included initial GPU sizing assumptions based on the workload notes. High-level thoughts:

- We can provision a Dedicated reserved pool after contract signature; typical lead time to guarantee a fixed tranche is ~6–8 weeks depending on region and SKU availability.
- Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem) requires image validation and runbook handoff — plan for 10–14 weeks end-to-end for guaranteed private delivery (longer if on-prem rack provisioning is involved).
- For evaluation/demo we usually recommend a smaller baseline with autoscale/burst available during peak runs to control cost while validating throughput.

I attached: MAP-draft.xlsx (draft milestones + owners) and gpu-sizing-assumptions.pdf (what we used to size baseline vs burst). Can Markus and Connor weigh in on the sizing and lead-time details?

Next step: I propose a 30-min align tomorrow to lock milestone dates and the demo slot. Are you available?

Warmly,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Director
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-draft.xlsx, gpu-sizing-assumptions.pdf]
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity support & MAP for evaluation -> reservation

Vanessa / Connor —

A couple of capacity/ops notes to make the MAP realistic:

- Sizing: From the workload summary, 2–3B tokens/month maps roughly to a sustained baseline of ~6 A100-equivalent GPUs for generation plus 2 GPUs for aux services (embeddings/ingest). For safe headroom during evaluation, recommend a baseline of 8 A100-equivalent with 2–4 burst slots for peak runs.

- Dedicated lead time: 6–8 weeks is achievable if we commit to a SKU and tranche (we reserve capacity on your behalf once contract & invoicing terms are agreed). If they need a specific GPU type (e.g., H100 vs A100), add an extra 2–3 weeks for procurement.

- Private (VPC/on-prem): 10–14 weeks includes: security checklist, image certification (1–2 weeks), runbook handoff (1 week), customer network validation (2–4 weeks), and any on-site ops (if on‑prem, +4 weeks). We should call out the validation window explicitly in the MAP so customers know when the "capacity reservation" is fully available.

- Contingency: Include fallback to hosted capacity with burst limits if physical delivery slips. Also note that we can soft-hold capacity earlier (with partial invoicing/commit) to shorten calendar risk.

I’ll add these bullets into the MAP draft and mark the lead-time checkpoints.

—Markus
Principal Product Manager, Capacity & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity support & MAP for evaluation -> reservation

Vanessa / Markus —

Thanks — that layout helps. A few clarifications from procurement & infra:

- Greenleaf would prefer a baseline of 6 GPUs with 2 dedicated burst slots for the pilot. That keeps ongoing costs down but still covers our performance windows. Is that feasible?
- We have a target demo date of 2027-01-20. Can Redwood guarantee the reserved capacity for that date if we sign by 2026-12-10?
- We attached our security questionnaire — can your security team fill and return within 7 business days? (Attachment: Greenleaf-Sec-Q-2026.docx)

If you can confirm the December sign-by date and the burst arrangement, procurement will put the deal into our budget calendar. Also, please highlight any contract language that would be required to guarantee capacity (SLA/commit clauses, invoicing timing).

Claire
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity support & MAP for evaluation -> reservation

Claire —

Attached is an updated MAP (MAP-draft.xlsx) with concrete checkpoints, owners, and two procurement options so you can choose:

Option A — Dedicated reservation (recommended for predictability):
- Sign by 2026-12-10 -> Redwood reserves a pool of 8 A100-equivalent GPUs for Greenleaf (6 baseline / 2 burst).
- Timeline: Contract signature -> invoice -> commitment -> capacity reserved within 6 weeks. Target guaranteed availability: 2027-01-20.

Option B — Private (VPC/on-prem):
- Sign by 2026-11-30 for image validation window to complete by 2027-01-10. Full private handoff expected in 10–14 weeks; target pilot availability 2027-02-08 (on-prem longer if rack changes are needed).

Key MAP milestones (owners):
1) Eval kickoff & dataset delivery — Claire / Greenleaf — 2026-11-22
2) Security questionnaire complete — Claire / Redwood Sec — 2026-11-30
3) PoC performance baseline (metrics) — Markus — 2027-01-10
4) Contract & PO issued — Procurement — 2026-12-10 (for Option A)
5) Capacity reservation confirmed — Redwood Capacity Team — 6 weeks after PO (target 2027-01-20)
6) Pilot commence — Greenleaf / Redwood — 2027-01-24

Notes / contingencies: if SKU availability shifts, we will offer an equivalent tranche and document the change in the MAP. If your legal requires a capacity SLA, we can include a section in the SOW for guaranteed tranche availability tied to invoicing milestones.

Links: HubSpot record (deal DL-7391) and DocuSign preview included.

[Attachment: MAP-draft.xlsx]

Please review and confirm the preferred option (A or B). If Option A works, we’ll prepare a redline-friendly SOW and send for signature.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Director
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity support & MAP for evaluation -> reservation

Vanessa —

We reviewed Option A and will proceed with Dedicated reservation. Procurement will target signature by 2026-12-08 (two days earlier than your proposed date) to give finance time. We request the demo slot 2027-01-20 be locked and for Redwood to include the capacity guarantee language in the SOW tied to the final invoice.

Also: can you accelerate the security questionnaire turnaround? If Redwood security can return answers by 2026-11-25, procurement can clear faster.

I’m attaching one small change to the MAP (shift the PoC baseline deadline to 2027-01-08). Otherwise, the timeline looks good. Please send the SOW redline and DocuSign when ready.

Thanks — Claire

[Attachment: Greenleaf-MAP-edits.xlsx]
